contexts.text: To prolong the days () = a happy state.
The days were there prolonged to him () = a state of reception.
To be prolonged is predicated of good, and its increase. AC 8898, Explained. AE 304:42.
The days being prolonged = happy to eternity.
The prolongation of the time. Signified.
To prolong, when said of the Lord, = duration to eternity.
He shall prolong His days () = the Divine good. Long, and thence prolong, are said of good.
The prolongation of their days (in the fourth commandment) = the happiness of eternal life.
